PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Stores a single authenticated player's ChibiMon 200 progression, preferences, and per-level records.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the player.

email.description: Verified Google account email address (PII, owner-only).

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google profile.

highestUnlockedLevel.description: Highest level unlocked by the player (1 to 200).

totalScore.description: Cumulative best score across all completed levels.

soundEnabled.description: Whether Web Audio sound effects are enabled.

levels.description: Map of level numbers ('1'..'200') to LevelProgress objects containing completed, stars, bestScore, and bestTimeRemaining.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player profile was last updated.

DiamondProfile.title: DiamondProfile
DiamondProfile.description: Stores a single authenticated player's Kim Cương 100 progression and per-level records.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the player.

highestUnlockedLevel.description: Highest Diamond Match-3 level unlocked by the player (1 to 100).

totalScore.description: Cumulative best score across completed Diamond levels.

levels.description: Map of level numbers ('1'..'100') to DiamondLevelProgress objects containing completed, stars, bestScore, and bestMovesLeft.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Diamond progression record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the Diamond progression record was last updated.

TowerDefenseProfile.title: TowerDefenseProfile
TowerDefenseProfile.description: Stores a single authenticated player's Vệ Thành Quái Thú (Tower Defense) campaign progression, star upgrades, and per-stage records.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the player.

highestUnlockedLevel.description: Highest Tower Defense stage unlocked by the player (1 to 30).

totalScore.description: Cumulative best score across completed Tower Defense stages.

bonusStars.description: Cumulative bonus stars earned from clearing stages (first-clear and repeat-clear stage rewards).

levels.description: Map of stage numbers ('1'..'30') to TdLevelProgress objects containing completed, stars, bestScore, and bestLivesLeft.

upgrades.description: Map of 10 standard upgrade track levels (0..5: archery, magic, barracks, artillery, support, economy, spells, citadel, lethality, mastery) and 4 stage-clear upgrade tracks (0..10: clearGold, clearPower, clearCitadel, clearArtifact).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Tower Defense progression record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the Tower Defense progression record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private ChibiMon 200 player progression document owned strictly by the matching Firebase Auth user.

/diamondProgress/{userId}.description: Private Kim Cương 100 player progression document owned strictly by the matching Firebase Auth user.

/towerDefenseProgress/{userId}.description: Private Vệ Thành Quái Thú (Tower Defense) player progression document owned strictly by the matching Firebase Auth user.
